components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action in a form or workflow section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 750 0.88rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); border-color: var(--accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet navigation or supporting action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 750 0.88rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-faint); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Text Action
components.description: A deliberately secondary destructive action with a confirmation step behind it.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 8px; color: var(--error); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 750 0.82rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--error-soft); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(169, 52, 43, 0.24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A readable white field with an explicit label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 7px; } .ds-field > span { color: var(--muted-strong); font: 750 0.78rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 400 15px/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #7fa99c; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus); outline: 0; }

components.name: Function Navigation
components.description: A labeled index that keeps the reader oriented within the CSF Functions.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px 14px 20px; background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 400 15px/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--line); } .ds-nav-item-active span { opacity: 0.78; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A text-labeled role, project, or response state.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 999px; font: 800 0.68rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Assessment Card
components.description: An expandable outcome row that keeps the code, title, coverage route, and detail body together.
components.css: .ds-assessment-card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); } .ds-assessment-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 76px; gap: 18px; padding: 16px 18px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: var(--surface); border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-assessment-summary:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-assessment-summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-outcome-code { color: var(--accent); font: 850 0.8rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-coverage-route { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); font: 600 0.68rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-expand-mark { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%; font: 400 1.1rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats every assessment as a calm working case file. White reading surfaces hold the content; the cool desk canvas gives pages and groups enough separation to scan; restrained teal marks the active Function, the next action, and the few statuses that need attention. The result is deliberately quiet because the product is used for long compliance-reading sessions, not quick dashboard glances.

The system keeps Counselor interpretation, Stakeholder response/evidence input, and Reviewer feedback visually legible as different kinds of work. Organization and project pages use structured lists and compact forms; assessment pages use an editorial reading column with expandable outcome cards. The visual language avoids gradients, decorative chrome, dense metric tiles, and heavy shadows that compete with compliance text.
keyCharacteristics: White-first work surfaces with a cool neutral page canvas.
Teal used as orientation and action, not as decoration.
Editorial reading measure with explicit Current / Target comparison.
Thin borders, modest corners, and one soft ambient shadow for raised panels.
Role-aware surfaces that distinguish reading, reviewing, and completing input.

rules.name: The Teal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Teal should explain where the reader is or what action is available; it should not fill whole sections without a functional reason.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Current, target, submitted, reviewed, error, and permission states use color alongside a visible text label.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Let hierarchy and a readable line length do the organizing; do not compensate for long compliance text with oversized decorative type.

rules.name: The Flat Workpaper Rule
rules.body: If a border and surface change can establish hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do keep compliance copy on white surfaces with a readable measure.
Do use the cool desk canvas and thin rules to group content before reaching for shadow.
Do reserve teal for active location, primary action, focus, and meaningful status.
Do distinguish Counselor interpretation from Stakeholder response/evidence input through layout and labels.
Do make Current and Target profiles visually distinct and textually labeled.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, role/status text, and responsive reading order at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't reintroduce gradients, glass effects, decorative illustrations, or dense dashboard chrome.
Don't use color alone to communicate response, coverage, or permission state.
Don't turn every list row into a raised card; use borders and tonal layers first.
Don't use a monospace or novelty display face as a technical costume.
Don't make Stakeholder input controls look like Counselor-owned profile editing controls.
Don't stretch assessment copy across the full viewport when a readable measure is available.
